show.description: Boss, Open Up Your Eyes is a high-stakes drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. When Swati is forced into a contract marriage with Abhinav, a powerful heir who wakes up from a coma, secrets begin to unravel—her true identity, his family’s ruthless motives, and a dangerous game of power. Between manipulation, revenge, and unexpected emotions, both must decide whether this marriage will destroy them or become their greatest strength.
